balls.text: four to end the innings, and MI finish with 243! Short ball, attempting to follow the batter outside leg. Rickelton swipes at it anyway and gets a top edge that clears the keeper. A streaky end to the innings, but take nothing away from a truly astonishing and world-class knock!
Rickelton goes big, and he is waging a lone battle still! This is a proper buffet ball. Knee-high full toss on off and Rickelton backs away to mow it over long on!
juicy full toss outside off. Minz tries to smash the cover off this and chunks it off the inside edge into his pad. Rickelton is alert enough to pinch a bye

clothed to long off, and SRH continue to turn the screw! Not quite a yorker outside off but full enough to deny Tilak from getting under it. The bat turns upon contact and he arrows it down Klaasen's throat. SRH have been frugal in these past few overs, and MI are losing momentum!
full toss outside off. Rickelton has a swing at it but it seems he has run out of gas now. Shanks it down to long off
zipped in full on the pads. Rickelton whips it away enough to long on's left and ambles back for a couple of runs
well-disguised slower ball, bashed into the track on middle and off. Tilak too early into his swipe and is lucky to see his stumps still intact
cutter into the track wide outside off. Rickelton fetches it and hoicks it towards deep square leg
slower ball on a back of a length on middle and off. Tilak winds up and drags it towards deep backward square leg
short ball down leg. Tilak shuffles across his stumps, swipes at it and misses. Not called a wide, rightly
oh, hello! Oh, hello! Right in the slot on the stumps. Tilak gets his front foot out of the way and boshes it over the bowler's head!

smashed straight to long off, and Sakib has gotten the better of the MI skipper! This is a slot ball but it is far outside off, meaning Hardik has to reach out. He tries to do so by going back and across but does not generate the power or elevation he wants. Simple catch for Klaasen, and Hardik has to depart for a 15-ball 31!
shortish outside off and this skids through too. Hardik has a swipe at it and muscles it down the ground to long off
brilliant wide yorker. Hardik cannot get his bat down in time and the ball squirms past the toe-end of the bat
full toss on middle and off. Rickelton a touch late to react and shanks it towards long on

slower bumper outside off and this balloons past the batter. Rickelton swings himself off his feet, quite literally, and the wide is called. SRH review. The ball seems to be passing above the batter. Top of Rickelton's head is measured at 1.84m and the ball is passing at 2.1m. Now the third umpire asks for UltraEdge. No bat involved, and the wide stays!
banged in short outside off. Hardik gets on top of the bounce and slaps it straight to deep extra cover
short and a mile outside off. Hardik lets it go and the umpire has no qualms in calling it a wide
into the blockhole just outside off. Hardik shanks it back past the stumps and has enough time to get back for two
this is a Hardik Pandya special! Misses the yorker on middle and leg by a smidgen, and Hardik climbs into it. Gets under this full ball and clubs it over long on!
back of a length outside off. Hardik hangs deep in his crease and dabs it towards backward point. Excellent over by the SRH skipper!
full and wide outside off. Rickelton throws his hands at it and powers it towards sweeper cover
top yorker, zoning into leg stump. Hardik clinks it out towards long on and has to settle for a single
slower bumper outside off. Rickelton opens up his stance and tugs it towards deep mid wicket
into the blockhole on middle and off. Hardik cannot get under it and jams it out towards long on
slow and short outside off. Rickelton jumps up onto his toes and scuffs it towards sweeper cover
excellent yorker on middle and off. Hardik clinks it out into the vacant mid wicket region and canters back for a brace
Hardik on the charge now! Yorker missed again and this is on the fuller side. Low full toss on off and Hardik shovels it over mid wicket!
Hardik lands his first authoritative punch! Hinge goes for the yorker outside off but misses on the shorter side. Hardik, sitting back, gets under it and mauls it over long on!
streaky but guess what, they all count! Bashed half-way down outside off. Hardik swings at it from the hip and the ball flies off the top edge over the keeper!
into the blockhole outside off. Rickelton jams down on it and squeezes it out towards backward point
Rickelton continues on his merry way! Another slower bumper outside off. Rickelton jumps out, swings his blade like an axe and top-edges it over short fine leg!

a hundred to savour! A dreamy innings in the city of dreams, and the Wankhede Stadium crowd loves it! Slower short ball outside off. Rickelton gets on top of the bounce and taps it into the on side. Leaps into the air the moment he completes the run, and punches the air in delight. The fastest hundred by an MI batter in the IPL, and this has been a knock right out of the top drawer!

has Rickelton gloved it?! Kishan thinks it has grazed the glove, but the umpire responds with a wide call! Another slower bumper, climbing through on leg. Rickelton is cramped for room and misses his swipe. A bit of excitement from SRH but no review
slower ball banged in short outside off. Rickelton jumps up onto his toes and dabs it to backward point
flat as a tank! Slower short ball on off and this sits up. Rickelton has all the time in the world to swivel and thump it over the long leg fence!
low full toss on the pads, and put away! Not the best ball to bowl with short fine leg up. Rickelton uses the pace and glances it past short fine leg!
hard length just outside off. Not a lot of room to work with for Hardik and he chops it into the off side
just short! Short and way outside off. Rickelton leaps at it to reach it and slaps it towards extra cover. Fell just in front of Cummins
fired in very full on middle and off. Rickelton squeezes it back past the bowler and nearly takes out his captain at the other end in the process
back of a length on the pads. Hardik nudges it to mid wicket and hares across to the other end

goes a mile up, and Hinge gets rid of Dhir! Zipped in full on leg and to be fair to Dhir, this is in the slot. He gets under it too much, though, and only gets the height he wants. Dubey, Hinge's Vidarbha teammate, settles under it at deep mid wicket and makes no mistake. Dhir's scratchy knock comes to an end!
banged in short again and the angle takes it outside off. Dhir swipes at it but the angle is too hard to fight again. Fresh-air shot
nails the yorker just outside off. Rickelton jams down on it and digs it out towards long off
starts off with a bumper outside off. Dhir catches up to it and tugs it to deep mid wicket
very full on leg and Dhir cannot do much with this either. Drilled down the ground to long off
slower ball goes wrong and this nearly lands on the adjacent strip on the off side. Left alone and the umpire just wants to check if this is a No ball. Only a wide
nails the yorker on the pads this time. Rickelton works it out towards deep backward square leg
darted in full on leg. Dhir steps out to the leg side a touch and drives it to long off
slower bumper outside off. Rickelton hops up onto his toes and drags it towards deep mid wicket
length on middle and off. Dhir waits for it before knocking it down to long on
banged in short on middle and leg. Rickelton is early on the pull and clinks it off the toe-end towards long on
smashed! Given a bit of air but in the slot again. On middle and leg and Dhir, backing away, smacks it over the bowler. Dubey did jump up but the ball was well past him by then!
flighted up a touch, full just outside leg. Dhir backs away but drives it straight to extra cover
darted in very full outside off. Rickelton cannot get under this and drills it to long off
full toss outside off and Dubey gets away with this. Rickelton slaps it back past the bowler and has to be content with two as Klaasen tumbles to his left at long off
change of angle makes no difference to Rickelton! Fired across the batter outside off but this too is in the slot. Rickelton bends his back knee and obliterates it over the bowler's head!
right out of the screws! Hung up on a length wide outside off. Rickelton gets down on one knee and whacks it over deep mid wicket!
shot! Slower ball on a full length outside off. Dhir waits for it, peels the outer cover off the ball and knifes it past backward point!
zipped in full on the pads. Rickelton tucks it towards deep backward square leg
short and too easy for Rickelton! Half-tracker on middle and off. Rickelton picks the slower one, swivels and pulls it past short fine leg!
shortish just outside off. Dhir hangs back and short-arm-jabs it towards deep mid wicket
pushed in fuller on middle and off. Rickelton comes forward and knocks it to long on
sharp bumper on middle and leg, and this sails through. Above the batter's head, though, meaning a wide is called once Rickelton swipes at thin air
back of a length outside off. Dhir gets on top of the bounce and punches it towards sweeper cover
slow, short, wide and punished! Sits up really nicely and Rickelton has oodles of room to work with. Jumps up onto his toes and slaps it past extra cover!
slower bumper outside off. Dhir gets on top of the bounce and pulls it towards deep square leg
what timing! Full outside off. Dhir gets onto the front foot and it seems like he merely pushes at it. The ball, though, flies off the blade and races away to mid off's left!
banged in short on middle and off. Rickelton gets up on his toes and pulls it towards deep backward square leg
fullish outside off again. Dhir stabs at it and jams it off the inside edge into his pads, with the ball rolling into the off side
fullish outside off. Dhir presses half forward and pushes it towards extra cover
zipped in full outside off. Dhir is late on his poke and chalks it off the toe-end towards backward point
slower short ball on middle and leg. Rickelton drags it towards short fine leg and scampers across to the other end

back of a length outside off. Dhir drops it towards backward point and wants the run. Rickelton sends him back but the fielder's throw is off the mark, with the backing-up not great either. Dhir off the mark courtesy an overthrow

skied, and SKY falls cheaply again! Bashed in short outside off and this climbs through on SKY. The ball gets big on him as he tries to swipe at it and the ball skews off the top edge. Abhishek moves around to his left at fine leg and snares the chance. SKY's lean run continues, and SRH have gone back-to-back!
banged in short outside off. SKY gets up on his toes and swats it to mid on
shortish on middle and leg, and this skids through. SKY looks to punch it through mid wicket but is late on the stroke. Jammed on the back thigh
very full outside off. Rickelton gets onto the front foot and drives it crisply past extra cover. Back for a brace
in the arc, and out of the park! Rickelton has his fifth IPL fifty! Full on the pads, and that is fodder for Rickelton. He plants his front foot and whips it over deep square leg!
this is another scorcher! Full outside off. Rickelton jams down on it and the ball pings off the bat and hurtles across the turf. Sweeper cover had no chance!
back of a length outside off. SKY presses half forward and jabs it towards sweeper cover
and SKY responds with a boundary! Short and wide outside off. SKY rides the bounce, keeps it down and glides it past backward point!

oh my - what an inspired bowling change! Nitish into the attack, and Nitish into the wickets! Length ball outside off and this seams away just a smidgen. Jacks throws his hands at it but for a change, does not middle it. Only musters a faint outside edge and Kishan does the rest. Big, big moment in the game!
loose ball and put away! Full toss speared down leg. Rickelton does not hit it too hard and uses the pace to help it past short fine leg!
shortish on middle and leg. Jacks rocks back and pulls it towards deep backward square leg
Jacks continues to motor along! Flighted up a little more but in the slot outside off. Jacks fetches it from outside the line and thumps it over long on!
tossed up on a fullish length wide outside off. He cannot do much with it and powers it to deep mid wicket
back of a length on middle and off. Rickelton hops back and punches it between long on and deep mid wicket for a couple of runs
fired in on a length on the pads. Jacks works it towards deep mid wicket and calls two. Abandons that idea mid-way, though
off-pace and dug in short, angling into off. Jacks waits on it before running it down to short third
slower ball on a length on off. Rickelton lets the ball come to him before patting it to long on
this is top-class batting! Length ball outside off and with everyone up, that is just asking for trouble. Rickelton gets his hands through the ball and blitzes it to cover's left!

do not bowl there to Ryan Rickelton! Slower ball dropped half-way down outside off and Rickelton reads it like today's newspaper. He picks his spot and demolishes it way over the deep mid wicket fence!
back of a length outside off and this seems like a cutter. Holds a little and Rickelton stabs it to mid off
Sakib travels too! Dug in short on middle and off, and that is right where Rickelton wants it. He swivels and dumps it over deep square leg!
finds the gap this time! Marginally short outside off. Jacks uses the depth of the crease, creates room and threads it between cover point and backward point!
short and wide outside off. Jacks hangs back but scuffs it straight to cover point
fetch this from the stands too! Pushed in on a length outside off. Jacks moves across his stumps, gets down on one knee and hoists it over deep backward square leg!
back of a length on off. Comes in with the angle and Jacks, backing away, taps it into the off side
fired in quicker and fuller on middle and leg. Jacks has a mow across the line and squirts it off the inside edge towards short fine
and Dube gets pumped first ball! Floated up into the slot on off. Jacks plants his front foot, goes through the line and slams it into the sightscreen!
another slower bumper, hung up wide outside off. Jacks waits for it before flat-batting it to long on
on a back of a length but a mile outside off. Left alone and called a wide
through the hands, and into Hinge's right ankle! Ball following Hinge now. On a length on the pads. Jacks swings it away and Hinge misfields on the half-volley at short fine

did that carry?! Banged in short outside leg. Gets big on Rickelton and he cannot control the spongy bounce. Rickelton top-edges his pull and Hinge, at short fine leg, does not react quick enough. Stays put and the ball lands just in front. Had he gone for it earlier, it might have carried
slower bumper outside off. Jacks reaches out in front and drags it into the square leg region
off-pace again, on a back of a length just outside leg. Rickelton has no clue about it and swishes too early. Misses it and the ball bobbles off the back thigh into the off side
slower ball on a length on middle and leg. Rickelton presses forward and pushes it back to the bowler
short, wide and Cummins gets away with one. Jacks gets on top of the bounce but cuts it straight to backward point
and Jacks goes over the off side! Full just outside off and more or less in the slot. Jacks opens his bat face a touch and carves it over extra cover!
full toss on the pads. Rickelton cannot quite make the most of it and flicks it towards deep mid wicket
fullish on middle and off. Rickelton comes forward and bunts it right between long on and deep mid wicket. Both batters scamper back for two
yorker sliding down leg. Rickelton jams down on it but cannot do so in time. Called a wide
picture perfect! Fullish just outside off and Rickelton climbs into it. He springs forward and crunches it back past the bowler!
more runs! And MI are motoring along now. On a back of a length just outside off. Rickelton picks the length early and slugs it over mid wicket!
shortish just outside off. Jacks backs away and swipes at it. Only connects with the fresh Mumbai air. That did not carry to the keeper either
just short! Back of a length outside off. Jacks throws his hands at it and the ball flies off the outside edge. Fielded superbly on the half-volley by Head at short third
a wild hack, and Jacks gets four more! A little ungainly. Banged in short outside off. Jacks hares down, tries to smash it into next week and top-edges it over the keeper!
that has sped to the fence! Shortish outside off and this sits up nicely. Jacks rises with the bounce and cracks it through point!
back of a length on middle and off. Rickelton tips it to mid on and saunters across to the other end
welcomed with a maximum! Length ball on middle and off, and that is right up Rickelton's wheelhouse. He plants his front foot and wallops it over mid wicket!
up and over! Fullish outside off and that is all Jacks needs. Not full of conviction and Jacks, actually, checks his stroke but he still lifts it enough over mid on!
on a length, slanting across the batter outside off. Rickelton jabs at it and chunks it off the inside half of the bat into the on side
oh! Length ball in the channel just outside off. Rickelton plants his front foot and swings for the hills. Makes no contact at all. Not far from off stump etiher
back of a length on middle and leg. No room to work with at all and Rickelton plays it back to the bowler
back of a length on middle and off. Rickelton gets behind the line of the ball and defends
into the blockhole first up, just outside off. Jacks jams down on it and digs it out towards cover point

a disdainful short-arm-jab, and SRH canter past MI to register the highest-ever run-chase in the IPL at this venue! Five on the trot for SRH, and MI have, once again, been blitzed out of the water at home! Back of a length and this sits up just outside off. Salil gets those fast hands through the ball and pummels it flat over deep mid wicket. Plenty of hugs and handshakes and smiles in the SRH camp. They were staring down at a mountain of runs, but have still managed to scale it with room to spare!
back of a length outside off and this seems to skid through. Salil keeps swiping at it but for a change, fails to make contact

another no-look six, and Salil is ripping MI to shreds at the death! Juicy full toss, agreed, but Salil's shot is another body blow to MI. Free swing through the line and he whacks it over wide long on!
chancy, but SRH will take that. Of course they will! Half-way down outside off. Salil swings himself off his feet and musters a top edge that hurtles over short fine leg!
low full toss just outside off. Salil digs it out towards long off and keeps strike

uff, Salil Arora, wow! Bumrah misses the yorker outside off and Salil greets him with a no-look shot. Goes through the line and does not even look up to see how far he has hit that over long off. Stunning, stunning shot!
slower ball banged in short outside off. Klaasen reaches out for it and drags it towards deep mid wicket
sharp bumper outside off. Klaasen looks to swipe it away but only chunks it off the inside edge into his body
Klaasen is in a hurry, and he is coming after Bumrah again! This is, admittedly, not a great ball. Full toss outside off and Klaasen bangs it over the bowler's head!
zipped in full on middle and off. Salil knocks it to long on and picks up another single
full toss on off. Salil tries to smoke this downtown but ends up miscuing it to long on
full outside off. Klaasen scuffs it towards mid off and ambles across to the other end
bashed in short on off. Salil gets rushed on the pull and splices it towards deep mid wicket

where have you been, Salil? Have you been batting in the nets all along?! Boult nails the wide yorker but the shot is just too good. Salil jams down on it and glides it between backward point and short third!

straight up the chimney, and Boult has a wicket, finally! Back of a length just outside off. Nitish looks to dump this over cow corner but the ball gets big on him. Clinks it a mile up off the top edge and SKY, circling under it at deep square leg, snaffles up the chance. Is there a twist in this game still?
very full outside off. Klaasen looks to pump it downtown but shanks it to long on. Klaasen livid with himself
Nitish joins in on the fun too! On a length outside off and Nitish creates all the room he wants. Gets his hands through the ball and crashes it past extra cover!
very full and honing into the stumps. Klaasen digs it out to long off
this is outrageously good, and Klaasen is playing this like a video game now! Darted in on a back of a length on off. Klaasen unfurls the reverse and crunches it over backward point!
on a length on middle and off. Nitish comes onto the front foot and knocks it to long on
fired in on a back of a length on off. Klaasen stabs it to deep mid wicket and remains content with a single
this is beautiful! Tossed up a touch, on a fullish length just outside leg. Klaasen gives himself room and caresses it over the wide long off fence. Brings up a 22-ball fifty too!
another top delivery. Boult sticks to the plan. Full and wide outside off. Nitish swishes at it with all his might but does not lay bat on ball
full and speared across the batter outside off. Nitish looks for the reverse lap and misses it. Not called a wide, rightly
another very full ball on the stumps. Klaasen cannot get under it and clinks it back pas tthe bowler
into the blockhole on the stumps. Nitish razes it back to the bowler, who gets his left boot in the way. Boult giving off some UCL vibes already...
full and wide outside off. Klaasen reaches out for it and drills it towards deep cover
zinged in full on middle and leg. Nitish has a stab at it and chunks it off the inside half of the bat towards deep mid wicket
very full outside off. Nitish comes forward and drives it towards long off
four more - and SRH are taking down MI's best bowler, again! Slower ball but this sits up on off. Nitish uses his wrists and whips it over square leg!
off-pace on a back of a length outside off. Nitish presses half forward and stabs it back to the bowler
zipped in very full on leg. Klaasen knocks it to long on and picks up a single

oh my days - play that on loop, and play that shot all night long! Phew. This is sumptuous. Just sumptuous. In the slot just outside off. Klaasen shows the maker's name and creams it over extra cover!
slower ball on a back of a length on off. Nitish bunts it into the mid wicket region
off the edge, and beyond short third! Dug in short outside off. Klaasen throws his hands at it and flays it over short third!
slower ball on a back of a length outside off. Klaasen gets on top of the bounce and punches it straight to extra cover. Klaasen tosses his bat up in the air in frustration
back of a length delivery wide outside off. Klaasen happy to let it go, and the umpire happy to call it a wide
hung up wide outside off again. Klaasen shoulders arms and the umpire has to signal for a wide again
full, wide and beyond the tramlines on the off side. Left alone and called a wide
banged in short outside off and this causes Klaasen problems again. Looks to upper-cut it but only grabs a handful of fresh air
nails the wide yorker again, and this sneaks just inside the tramlines. Klaasen tries to jam it out and is late on it
right into the blockhole outside off. Klaasen cannot do much with it and clinks it back to the bowler
full and wide outside off. Nitish throws his hands at it and slices it towards deep backward point

another bumper outside off, and Klaasen is doing this with surgical precision! Could not have found that gap better even if he tried again. Sits up and Klaasen, rolling his wrists, pings it between long on and deep mid wicket!
four more - and Klaasen is toying with the bowling now! This, though, is also a bit of a gift. Knee-high full toss outside off and Klaasen cracks it to extra cover's right!
watch out, umpire! Another half-tracker outside off. Klaasen has time and he blasts it over the bowler. Umpire had to duck for cover too!
full toss outside off. Nitish drives it down the ground to long off
another short ball. Pace-on this time and at the body. Klaasen gets on top of it and pulls it towards deep backward square leg
shot! Slower bumper outside off but the width is the problem again. Klaasen stands up on his toes and forehands it, with a bit of top spin, past extra cover!
hung up full and wide. Klaasen goes through the line and drills it towards sweeper cover
another drag-down, and Klaasen latches onto it! Sits up nicely and Klaasen has enough swinging room to work with. Not right off the middle but enough mustard on it to clear the deep mid wicket fence!
Klaasen with his first punch! Marginally short outside off. Klaasen spots the length early, rocks back and hammers it over mid wicket!
angled in on a length on middle and leg. Klaasen pokes it to mid wicket
floated up full and wide. Nitish tries to hit it too hard and scuffs it to long off
clever shot! Fired in full down leg. Nitish gets inside the line and taps the ball on its head, helping it past the keeper!

a direct hit, and Nitish may have been struggling! Full outside off. Nitish tips it to mid off and calls for a risky single. Has to fly like a superhero to get there. Also saved by there being no direct hit. SKY the fielder
back of a length just outside off. Nitish gets up on his toes and pats it into the off side

squeezed out to extra cover, and MI are turning this game around! Sticks to the plan - very full and outside off. Head looks to carve it through the off side but cannot get under it enough. Cannot keep it down either and the ball arrows to extra cover, where Jacks snaps down ot his left and gobbles up the chance. MI in the ascendancy!
full outside off. Klaasen throws his hands at it and slices it towards sweeper cover
low full toss hung up wide outside off. Head reaches out for it and clinks it out towards deep cover
dug in short on off. Klaasen rolls his wrists nicely and pulls it towards deep square leg
back of a length on the pads. Klaasen tucks it to deep square leg and denies Ghazanfar a hat-trick

third time is really the charm! Dragged on, and this crowd is going ballistic now! Back of a length outside off. Seems like the one that spins in and the ball seems to hold a touch too. Kishan has a loose dab at it and chops it onto his stumps. Ghazanfar is pumped, and MI have a foothold in this contest!

catch it is the cry again and this time, it is taken! And the Wankhede finds its voice! Ghazanfar dangles the carrot outside off. Full enough to make Abhishek bite too but like the previous ball, he slices across it too much. Boult moves to his left from backward point and does the rest. Ghazanfar is fired up, but take nothing away from another tone-setting and bruising Abhishek knock!
a bit of a slice but it is safe! Hung up full outside off. Abhishek cuts across his lofted shot but it lands well in front of long off, who was running to his right
flighted up very full just outside off. Abhishek cannot get under it and chalks it back to the bowler
shortish outside off. Head goes back and cuts it towards sweeper cover
low full toss on leg. Head gets his feet out of the way and flicks it towards deep mid wicket
fetch this too, says Travis H! Hardik misses the yorker on the shorter side. Slot ball on the pads and Head shovels it over long on!
top yorker, zoning into the pads. Abhishek clinks it out to long on
slower bumper just outside leg. Head is early into his swipe but does well to roll his wrists. Tugs it to deep backward square leg
low full toss on the pads. Abhishek eases it out to deep mid wicket
into the blockhole on middle and leg. Head jams down on it and squeezes it out towards short fine leg
angled in on a length on leg. Head comes forward and knocks it to long on to keep strike
there is no stopping this! Full outside off. Head creates room for himself again and blasts it past extra cover!
another catch....but for those in the crowd! Slower bumper on off. Head gives himself ample room, jumps up onto his toes and slashes it over backward point!

has Dhir landed on the cushion, or has he pushed it back into play in time?! Full just outside off. Head gives himself room and flays it towards sweeper cover. Dhir leaps to his left, takes it but then lands on the cushion before he can get rid of it. The catches are following Dhir, and he is crumbling under that pressure tonight!
into the blockhole on middle and leg. Abhishek jams down on it and digs it out towards long on
this is awesome batting! Length ball outside off. Abhishek steps forward, stands tall and creams it over extra cover. One bounce and into the fence!
bashed in short outside off and this balloons over the batter's head. Left alone and called a wide
full just outside off. Abhishek comes forward and pushes it towards long on
this is another special stroke, and Bumrah is being taken to the cleaners! Dug in short on middle and off. Abhishek charges, creates room and scythes it over backward point!
full toss outside off, bowled from around the wicket. Abhishek opens his bat face and drives it straight to cover point
banged in short on leg. Head swipes at it and cops a blow near the ribs for his troubles. Ball rolls into the off side for a single
this is vintage Travis Head! SRH were crying out for him to arrive, and he has arrived tonight. Slower ball bowled full on middle and off. Head opens his bat face and carves it over backward point!
goodness gracious me - Head has feasted on this! Right in the slot on middle and off. Head plants his front foot and clatters it a mile over the bowler's head. A 99m six!
12 off Ghazanfar's opening over! This is a loose ball. Carrom ball sliding down leg. Abhishek uses the pace and tickles it fine past the keeper!
pushed in full on middle and off. Head eases it to long off
insult to injury! And Head is rollicking along now! In the slot on leg stump. Head gets down on one knee and thunders it enough to deep mid wicket's right!
another chance goes begging! Short outside off. Head throws his hands at it and slices it towards backward point. Dhir leaps up into the air again but can only palm it over the bar
back of a length outside off and this spins away. Head has a wild whoosh at it and misses
very full just outside off. Abhishek cannot get under it and drills it towards long off
that is so nonchalant! Full toss on the pads. Head could have hit it into the sea but instead, he opts for a simple bunt that hits the turf and gallops away through mid wicket!
Head wants a piece of Jacks too! Darted into the slot on leg, and Head says thank you very much. He plants his front foot and smokes it over mid on!
fired in full on off. Abhishek comes forward and knocks it to long off
dispatched! This is shorter just outside off and Abhishek is waiting for it. He opens up his stance and belts it over mid on!
floated up deliciously on a fullish length outside off. Abhishek thinks about swishing at it before letting it go
up and over, just! Given lots of air, on a full length just outside leg. Abhishek backs away but is early into his lofted stroke. Gets just enough to chip it beyond mid on!
back of a length outside off and this shapes away late. Head has a loose waft at it and sees the ball sneak past the outside edge
oh my - this has gone a mile! Length ball, angling into leg stump. Head telegraphs the line, shimmies inside it and dumps it into the top deck over fine leg!
no chance for anyone this time! Length outside off and that is Head's cue to throw the lot at it. Much better contact and he flays it over point!
back of a length on middle and off. Head gets squared up, while also being caught on the crease, and drops it into the off side
this is outside off again, on a back of a length, and tempting Head into another big shot. He tries but only connects with fresh air this time
bursts through the hands! Length ball hung up wide outside off. Head throws the plumbing at it and slices it towards deep backward point. Dhir jumps up but the ball goes right through his palms!
some excitement again, but no review! Sharp bumper just outside leg. Abhishek is rushed on the pull and seems to miss it. A few oohs and aahs, but not enough conviction to take it upstairs!
four more! Not off the bat but SRH and Abhishek will take it. Back of a length and sneaking down leg. Abhishek misses it but the ball takes enough of the thigh pad to dribble past the keeper!
stunning hit! Slower ball on a back of a length on middle and off. Abhishek picks the variation early, swings through the line and launches it over mid on!
short and sliding down leg this time. Abhishek swings and misses, and the umpire has to stretch out his arms again
short and way outside off. Abhishek lets it go and the umpire has to indulge in some exercise
back of a length outside off, shaping away. Head uses the angle and dabs it towards deep backward point
full toss just outside off and Head misses out. Jabs it straight to cover and Bumrah will also feel he got away with that
back of a length just outside off. Abhishek lets the ball come to him before running it down to deep backward point
Length ball outside off, the away movement there again, Abhishek punches it out to deep backward point

Oh, was that a chance? Head pokes at this length ball that seams away and gets a thick outside edge this time. Goes to Jacks' left at short third and he dives and sticks his left hand out. Just can't make it stick. Tough chance, and Boult appreciates the effort
On a length around off, and it straightens off the seam. Head stabs at it and steers it to short third
On a length outside off, punched away through point. They get a single
Back of length delivery, this one slides down leg as well. Abhishek looked to help it along and Rickelton thought there was some bat on it, but the umpire isn't interested
Now Boult fires one down leg side
And there we go! The chase begins in style. On a length on middle and Abhishek just walks across leg side to make some room and lofts this inside out over cover.
Outswinging yorker outside off, Abhishek digs it out towards cover point
